kitty-keyboard.failed: {name} does not speak the kitty keyboard protocol, so ⇧⌫ arrives as ⌫ and ⌥ with an arrow as two keys

emoji-width.failed: {name} draws 📚 in {emoji_width} cell(s), not two, so kittui's columns shift

ambiguous-width.failed: {name} draws ↑ in {ambiguous_width} cells, not one, so kittui's arrows and rules shift

findings.line: iTerm2 runs the triggers of profile {profile} on every line kittui repaints
findings.held: iTerm2 runs no trigger of profile {profile} while kittui is up
findings.fix: iTerm2 → Settings → Profiles → {profile} → Advanced → Triggers: untick Enabled in interactive apps

findings.line: iTerm2's profile {profile} sends ⌥ as a plain key, so ⌥ with an arrow never reaches kittui as one
findings.fix: iTerm2 → Settings → Profiles → {profile} → Keys → General: set Left Option key to Esc+

findings.line: iTerm2's profile {profile} does not let apps change how keys are reported, so kittui gets no kitty keyboard protocol
findings.held: iTerm2's profile {profile} lets apps change how keys are reported
findings.fix: iTerm2 → Settings → Profiles → {profile} → Keys → General: tick Apps can change how keys are reported

findings.line: iTerm2's profile {profile} does not report mouse clicks, so a click never reaches kittui
findings.fix: iTerm2 → Settings → Profiles → {profile} → Terminal: tick Enable mouse reporting, and Report mouse clicks & drags

findings.line: iTerm2's profile {profile} turns off the alternate screen, so kittui's frames pile up in the scrollback
findings.held: iTerm2's profile {profile} keeps the alternate screen
findings.fix: iTerm2 → Settings → Profiles → {profile} → Terminal: untick Disable save/restore alternate screen

findings.line: iTerm2's profile {profile} measures with Unicode 8 widths, so 📚 takes one cell and kittui's columns shift
findings.held: iTerm2's profile {profile} measures with Unicode 9 widths
findings.fix: iTerm2 → Settings → Profiles → {profile} → Text: tick Use Unicode version 9+ widths

findings.line: iTerm2's profile {profile} draws ambiguous characters double-width, so ↑ and kittui's rules take two cells
findings.held: iTerm2's profile {profile} draws ambiguous characters in one cell
findings.fix: iTerm2 → Settings → Profiles → {profile} → Text: untick Ambiguous characters are double-width

findings.line: iTerm2's profile {profile} does not use UTF-8, so kittui's glyphs draw wrong
findings.fix: iTerm2 → Settings → Profiles → {profile} → Terminal: set Character encoding to Unicode (UTF-8)

findings.line: Terminal's profile {profile} does not use ⌥ as Meta, so ⌥ with an arrow never reaches kittui as one; turning it on breaks layouts such as AZERTY
findings.fix: Terminal → Settings → Profiles → {profile} → Keyboard: tick Use Option as Meta key

findings.line: Terminal's profile {profile} draws ambiguous characters wide, so ↑ and kittui's rules take two cells
findings.held: Terminal's profile {profile} draws ambiguous characters in one cell
findings.fix: Terminal → Settings → Profiles → {profile} → Advanced: untick Unicode East Asian Ambiguous characters are wide

findings.line: Terminal's profile {profile} does not use UTF-8, so kittui's glyphs draw wrong
findings.fix: Terminal → Settings → Profiles → {profile} → Advanced: set Text encoding to Unicode (UTF-8)

kitty-keyboard.none: Terminal has no kitty keyboard protocol, so kittui offers > and < for ⌥ with an arrow

findings.line: Ghostty sends ⌥ as a plain key on this keyboard layout, so ⌥ with an arrow never reaches kittui as one
findings.fix: add macos-option-as-alt = left to Ghostty's config, then reload it

findings.line: Ghostty turns ⌥← and ⌥→ into ⌥b and ⌥f, so kittui never sees ⌥ with an arrow
findings.fix: add keybind = alt+left=unbind and keybind = alt+right=unbind to Ghostty's config

findings.line: Ghostty does not report the mouse, so a click never reaches kittui
findings.fix: remove mouse-reporting = false from Ghostty's config

findings.line: Ghostty measures widths the legacy way, so some emoji take the wrong number of cells
findings.fix: set grapheme-width-method = unicode in Ghostty's config

findings.line: kitty sends ⌥ as a plain key, so ⌥ with an arrow never reaches kittui as one
findings.fix: add macos_option_as_alt left to kitty.conf, then restart kitty: a reload does not apply it

findings.line: kitty's config grabs a plain left click for kitty, so it never reaches kittui
findings.held: kitty passes a plain click to kittui
findings.fix: remove the mouse_map left press grabbed line from kitty.conf

findings.line: WezTerm takes ⌥⏎ to toggle full screen, so kittui never sees it
findings.fix: add { key = 'Enter', mods = 'ALT', action = wezterm.action.DisableDefaultAssignment } to config.keys in {config}

findings.line: Alacritty sends ⌥ as a plain key, so ⌥ with an arrow never reaches kittui as one
findings.fix: add option_as_alt = "OnlyLeft" under [window] in {config}

findings.line: Warp sends ⌥ as a plain key, so ⌥ with an arrow never reaches kittui as one
findings.fix: Warp → Settings → Features → Keys: turn on Left Option key is Meta

findings.line: Warp does not report the mouse, so a click never reaches kittui
findings.fix: Warp → Settings → Features → Terminal: turn on Enable Mouse Reporting
